implementation.search: The modal filters real accepted friends by display name or username and distinguishes an empty result.
implementation.delivery: Each recipient creates or reuses a real DM, awaits the actual encrypted send result, shows sending/sent/failed state, and permits retry only after failure without duplicating successful sends.
implementation.link: The exact share URL displayed and copied is also sent in DMs; server-scoped request deduplication prevents create races and stale server data is rejected.
implementation.expiry: User-facing share links and the invite settings editor default to seven days. Settings retain explicit duration and use-limit choices; server validation enforces expiry and exhaustion.

remaining_acceptance: Verify two-client DM delivery, rate-limit recovery, exhausted/revoked links and keyboard/zoom behavior. Target-channel and private-channel warning remain separate missing coverage items.
